hero.title: Democracy, human rights and the rule of law must continue to be protected
hero.lead: I am a Peruvian lawyer and public policy specialist in Berlin. For more than ten years I have worked on democratic governance, human rights and civil society, implementing projects in Latin America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and Asia. This page is my expression of interest for Head of Democracy at ECNL.

bio.title: Short biography
paragraphs: I am a Peruvian lawyer and public policy specialist based in Berlin, with more than ten years of experience in democratic governance, human rights and civil society.

Until August 2026 I  was Executive Director of the International Federation of Liberal Youth (IFLRY), a global federation of more than 100 member organisations in over 60 countries, where I led strategy, fundraising and donor relations with partners, together with the board.

Before that, I drafted legislation as an advisor in the Peruvian Congress and worked on transparency and accountability at Peru's Office of the Comptroller General. My human rights work began at the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights. She later trained Cuban activists to use the Inter-American system and helped draft reports that Cuban civil society organisations submitted to the Commission.
I co-founded Somos Ciudadanía, a Peruvian civic education NGO, and holds a law degree from Universidad de San Martín de Porres and a Master of Public Policy from the Hertie School.

ai.title: The use of AI in our daily life
ai.text: AI now decides who is seen at a protest, (using to track people with cameras) which posts stay online(trough filtering) and who gets a public service(social credit system). The future and its rules are being shaped every day for governments and builders of technology. It is important that civil society keep a voice in the construction.

points.title: Assembly
points.text: Facial recognition and surveillance can make people afraid to gather in public.

points.title: Expression
points.text: Automated moderation shapes what can be said, often with no way to appeal.

points.title: Participation
points.text: Digital public services and consultations can leave out people who are already unheard.

ai.use: I use AI in the creative process of implementing ideas. Difficult to imagine how the future will look like, but AI is an instrumental part of how that future is being shaped, however, we humans are and we keep remain as the main actor of the process.
